newsitem.title: JAPAN: Turner, Itochu, Time Warner announce Japan channel.
newsitem.headline: Turner, Itochu, Time Warner announce Japan channel.

text.p: Turner Broadcasting System Asia Pacific Inc, Itochu Corp and Time Warner Entertainment Japan Inc (TWEJ) said on Wednesday they would jointly launch Japan's first 24-hour cartoon channel on September 1.

The firms said in a statement that the channel, Cartoon Network Japan, will be in the Japanese language, and will feature Japanese and Western animation. It will include cartoons from Time Warner's animation library, which features more than 10,000 titles from Warner Bros, Hanna Barbera and MGM.
The network will be delivered to subscribers in Japan via satellite and cable providers, including PerfecTV from the JCSAT-3 satellite.
PerfectTV is a venture owned by a consortium of Japanese trading companies which began services last year.
TWEJ is a joint venture company of Time Warner, the U.S. West Media Group, Itochu and Toshiba Corp.
"We will strive for a synergistic effect on various businesses which are being conducted in Japan by these four partners," Takeshi Okatomi, president and CEO of TWEJ said in the statement.
